description: This file defines the WellKnownTypeCollection class, which manages a collection of well-known types and their identifiers within the Orleans serialization framework. It provides methods to retrieve types by ID, check for type existence, and map types to IDs.

classes.name: WellKnownTypeCollection
classes.description: A sealed class that manages a collection of well-known types and their associated identifiers, providing methods for type retrieval and mapping.

methods.name: WellKnownTypeCollection
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the collection using configuration options containing type IDs.

methods.name: GetWellKnownType
methods.description: Retrieves the type associated with a given type ID, returning null if the ID is zero.

methods.name: TryGetWellKnownType
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a type for a given type ID, indicating success with a boolean return value.

methods.name: TryGetWellKnownTypeId
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the type ID associated with a given type, indicating success with a boolean return value.
